subject: Nimbus Advisors — GCP Marketplace co-sell pilot & integration governance

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbusadvisors.com>

Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x Nimbus — quick pilot intake for GCP Marketplace co-sell

Hi Jonas,

Great to connect last week — thanks for the time. Nimbus is ready to move from discovery to a short co-sell pilot for GCP Marketplace (private listing + joint demo pipeline). Before we spin up engineering work, can we capture a short technical intake so we can scope the integration and the mutual action plan?

Top-line asks from our side:
- Confirm listing model: private marketplace listing (publisher + reseller flow) and whether Redwood can provide a publisher SKUs mapping for resale.
- Integration surface: connector for SSO (SAML/SCIM), automated metering events (usage webhook or pull), and an optional demo integration for the joint demo (embed Redwood SDK).
- Security evidence: we typically ask for SOC 2 Type II summary and a list of supported regions/data residency controls for GCP.

Can your team do a technical intake call next week? Proposed slots: Tue May 6 10:00am PT or Wed May 7 2:00pm PT. If you prefer, we can capture answers asynchronously — I attached our high-level pilot schematic to help the scoping.

Attaching: nimbus-mmp-schematic.png (png)

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Liam Chen
Partnerships Lead, Nimbus Advisors
liam.chen@nimbusadvisors.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Nimbus — quick pilot intake for GCP Marketplace co-sell

Hi Liam — thanks for the schematic, looks good. Looping in Olga (Product Partnerships) and Ben (Marketplace GTM) to cover product and catalog requirements.

Quick answers and next steps from Redwood:
- Listing model: We support private and public marketplace workflows. For a private co-sell pilot we usually create a private listing and provide a SKU mapping for the reseller flow. Ben will confirm the SKU pattern and billing path.
- Integration surface: SAML for SSO + SCIM provisioning is straightforward. For metering we can do both push (webhook) and pull; we'll recommend webhook for near-real-time attribution.
- Security evidence: We can provide SOC 2 summary and a short evidence packet (network topology, data retention, and KMS details). Olga, can you confirm retention windows for GCP regions?

Proposed intake: 30-minute technical sync to agree scope and action owners. I can do Tue May 6 10:00am PT. Ben/Olga — can you make that? If not, Wed May 7 2:00pm PT also works.

We’ll draft a one-page mutual action plan after the call with milestones (catalog entry, demo, metering test, contract signature). Also tagging legal early — Liam, if you have a template MOU we can sign, send it along and we’ll route to legal.

Jonas Weber
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nimbusadvisors.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 01 May 2025 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Nimbus — quick pilot intake for GCP Marketplace co-sell

Perfect — Tue May 6 10:00am PT works for us.

Regarding legal, I’ve attached a short MOU for a pilot (two-page) — if that’s acceptable we can sign via DocuSign. Also: two quick technical clarifications ahead of the call so our engineering leads come prepared:
1) Does Redwood require any special auth scope for metering webhook payloads (we typically sign with a shared secret + HMAC).
2) For the private listing, will Redwood request any billing metadata keys from us (e.g., partner_id, resale_class)? If so we’ll map that in our billing pipeline.

Attaching: mou-nimbus-redwood-signed.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

— Liam
